title: Puthoff-Green-Davis email chain on alien autopsy

tellings.quote: an email chain with how put off Kit Green and Eric Davis talking about the Santilly alien autopsy film and so forth. And Kit Green saying he saw different pictures of an alien autopsy.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb describes a chain of emails from around 2001 and 2002 between a physicist named Hal Puthoff, a man named Kit Green and another physicist, Eric Davis. In it, he says, they discuss the Santilli alien autopsy film, a 1990s film said to show doctors cutting open an alien body, and Green says he had seen different pictures of an alien autopsy. If true, it would mean other images of alien bodies exist beyond the famous film.
